description: Availability and certificate monitoring - the evidence that the safeguards were actually running.
_doc: Its socket.io API is unversioned and has changed between releases, so the Sentinel monitor adapter is written against one verified build. A break here is silent - monitors quietly stop being managed and nothing looks wrong - which is why the upgrade is harness-gated.

harnessGate.doc: upgrade/upgrade.sh refuses to move this image unless versions/manifest.json marks the target harness_passed. There is no --force: a break in this family does not look like an outage.

preUninstallExport.description: pg_dump of every database, a tarball per volume, host state, config and an EXPORT-MANIFEST.json. Runs BEFORE anything is removed; skipping takes a typed confirmation.

health.doc: Run from the module's directory in the installer checkout; exit 0 means healthy. Several modules have no HTTP surface to probe, and pulse's probe must assert the pinned build is the one running rather than merely that something answered.
